title: Shehr e sarwar
body:
Shehr e sarwar
Shehr E SARWAR AS ki aabo hawa or hai. - 6
<<DIVIDER>>
Jannaten or hain karbala or hai.-2
Shehr E SARWAR AS ki aabo hawa or hai. -2
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Mai hun beemar jane de karbobala - 4
Ay tabeeb is maraz ki dawa or hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shehr E SARWAR AS...
2) Dusra koi SHABBIR AS kaise mile-4
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya KHUDA k alawa KHUDA or hai.
Shehr E SARWAR AS..
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Sath phoolo'n k sar bhi chadhao yahan - 3
Maqbare or hain Taziya or hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shehr E SARWAR - 2
4) Ay mufassir bata kya tamasha hai ye-3
<<DIVIDER>>
Aayaten or hain tarjuma or hai.
Shehr E SARWAR - 3
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Dusro'n se ALI AS ka taqabul hi kya - 3
Hadse or hai mojza or hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shehr E SARWAR AS - 3
6) hans k deewar - 3
<<DIVIDER>>
Hans k dewar E kabah ye Kehne lagi - 3
UMME HAIDER AS tera rasta or hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shehr E SARWAR AS - 3
7) Boli Mariyam taqabul na karna mera - 4
<<DIVIDER>>
KIBRIYA ki qasam FATEMA SA or hain.
Shehr E SARWAR AS - 3
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Airo ghairo ki midhat mai karta nahi - 2
Main Hu Nayab meri ana or hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Shehr E SARWAR AS ki aabo hawa or hai - 2
author: Mir Hassan Mir
